title: Countable powers and the multiplication difference
statement: Let $B$ be a category with countable products. Define the countable-power functor $P(M)=\prod_{j\geq0}M$ with coordinatewise action on morphisms. In a preadditive category it is additive; it preserves limits whenever those limits exist. For a small ringed site with commutative coefficient sheaf $O$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], an object $U$ and $f\in O(U)$, define the natural endomorphism $\Delta_f$ on countable powers of module sheaves on the slice by $(x_j)\mapsto(x_j-fx_{j+1})$. Multiplication by $f$ at an object $V\to U$ means multiplication by the restriction of $f$.
